candidate_hand_counts.description: Integer occupancy tensor over deduplicated candidate hands and 34 ordinary tile types; red fives contribute to their ordinary type counts.
candidate_hand_counts.encoding: First axis: hand-bank slot, with slot 0 the current hand. Validity is determined by candidate_hand_valid.

candidate_hand_red.description: Per-candidate red-five occupancy by suit, represented separately from ordinary type counts.
candidate_hand_red.encoding: First axis: hand-bank slot, with slot 0 the current hand. Validity is determined by candidate_hand_valid.

candidate_melds.description: Per-candidate public meld histogram indexed by lowest tile type and six meld/red channels.
candidate_melds.encoding: Axes: hand slot, lowest meld tile (34), channel (6). Channels: 0 chi, 1 pon, 2 open kan, 3 closed kan, 4 added kan, 5 red-five counts at their ordinary five tile.

candidate_hand_valid.description: Binary occupancy mask for the 96-entry candidate-hand axis.
candidate_hand_valid.encoding: First axis: hand-bank slot, with slot 0 the current hand. Validity is determined by candidate_hand_valid.

discard_candidate_hand.description: Gather indices from 37 discard actions into the deduplicated candidate-hand bank.
discard_candidate_hand.encoding: Integer index into the 96-slot hand bank. Action legality masks determine which entries are meaningful.

chi_candidate_hand.description: Gather indices from the chi-pattern × follow-up-discard action grid into the candidate-hand bank.
chi_candidate_hand.encoding: Integer index into the 96-slot hand bank. Action legality masks determine which entries are meaningful.

pon_candidate_hand.description: Gather indices from the pon × follow-up-discard action grid into the candidate-hand bank.
pon_candidate_hand.encoding: Integer index into the 96-slot hand bank. Action legality masks determine which entries are meaningful.

kan_candidate_hand.description: Gather indices from tile-specific kan candidates into the candidate-hand bank.
kan_candidate_hand.encoding: Integer index into the 96-slot hand bank. Action legality masks determine which entries are meaningful.

meld_type.description: Categorical observed-meld kind with zero padding, indexed by relative player and meld slot.
meld_type.encoding: 0 padding, 1 chi, 2 pon, 3 open kan, 4 closed kan, 5 added kan. Valid slots are marked by meld_valid.

meld_tile_ids.description: Ordinary tile-type IDs for public meld constituent slots.
meld_tile_ids.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

meld_tile_red.description: Binary red-five indicators aligned with public meld constituent slots.
meld_tile_red.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

meld_tile_valid.description: Binary occupancy mask over public meld constituent slots.
meld_tile_valid.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

meld_source.description: Categorical actor-relative source-seat index for each public call, with zero for closed/no-source entries.
meld_source.encoding: 0 closed/no source; otherwise actor-relative source seat + 1.

meld_call_age.description: Clipped event-distance scalar from the original meld event, normalized by 100.
meld_call_age.encoding: min(1, elapsed public events / 100); axes: four relative players × four meld slots.

meld_upgrade_age.description: Clipped event-distance scalar from an added-kan upgrade, normalized by 100.
meld_upgrade_age.encoding: min(1, elapsed public events / 100); axes: four relative players × four meld slots.

meld_valid.description: Binary occupancy mask over each player’s four public meld slots.
meld_valid.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

current_draw_tile_id.description: Ordinary tile-type ID of the current self draw, interpreted under current_draw_valid.
current_draw_tile_id.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

current_draw_is_red.description: Binary red-five indicator for the current self draw.
current_draw_is_red.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

current_draw_valid.description: Binary validity mask for current-draw identity channels.
current_draw_valid.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

normal_self_shanten.description: Clipped categorical standard-hand shanten encoding; category equals actual shanten + 1 until saturation.
normal_self_shanten.encoding: 0 complete, 1 tenpai, 2 one-shanten, 3 two-shanten, 4 three-or-more shanten; 5 marks an unavailable special family with fixed melds.

chiitoitsu_self_shanten.description: Clipped categorical seven-pairs shanten encoding with a distinct infeasible-family sentinel when fixed melds exist.
chiitoitsu_self_shanten.encoding: 0 complete, 1 tenpai, 2 one-shanten, 3 two-shanten, 4 three-or-more shanten; 5 marks an unavailable special family with fixed melds.

kokushi_self_shanten.description: Clipped categorical thirteen-orphans shanten encoding with a distinct infeasible-family sentinel when fixed melds exist.
kokushi_self_shanten.encoding: 0 complete, 1 tenpai, 2 one-shanten, 3 two-shanten, 4 three-or-more shanten; 5 marks an unavailable special family with fixed melds.

closed_hand.description: Binary closed-hand predicate used by structural/scoring constraints.
closed_hand.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

self_efficiency.description: Three normalized self-hand statistics: actual shanten, improving-type cardinality and available improving-copy count.
self_efficiency.encoding: Last axis: [actual shanten / 8, improving tile types / 34, available improving copies / 80].

self_yaku_possibility.description: Nineteen binary public structural-feasibility channels for the current self hand.
self_yaku_possibility.encoding: Last axis (boolean public feasibility, not win probability): 0 tanyao, 1 haku, 2 hatsu, 3 chun, 4 round wind, 5 seat wind, 6 honitsu, 7 chinitsu, 8 toitoi, 9 chiitoitsu, 10 shousangen, 11 daisangen, 12 tsuuiisou, 13 chinroutou, 14 honroutou, 15 kokushi, 16 chanta, 17 junchan, 18 iipeikou.

dora_tile_id.description: Ordinary tile-type IDs of the visible dora indicators, padded to five slots.
dora_tile_id.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

dora_valid.description: Binary occupancy mask for the visible dora-indicator axis.
dora_valid.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

dora_multiplicity.description: Per-ordinary-tile integer multiplicity induced by visible dora indicators.
dora_multiplicity.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

public_visible_red_counts.description: Public red-five occupancy by suit, excluding concealed self occupancy.

prevailing_wind.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

any_player_at_or_above_30000.encoding: Shapes exclude batch; seats are actor-relative (self 0, opponents 1–3). Masks use 0/1.

nodes.title: Public state tensors
nodes.summary: Actor-relative native feature tensors and deterministic post-action hand indices.
details: Inference inputs exclude opponent concealed-hand state and supervised hidden-state labels.
The native schema fixes tensor order, scalar dtype, shape and byte offset.

nodes.title: Shared hand bank
nodes.summary: Shared suit-local residual convolutions produce embeddings for occupied candidate-hand entries.
details: Each suit stack uses kernel-3 convolutions with dilation rates 1, 2 and 4 and residual LayerNorm/GELU updates.
Honor-tile features use a separate 128-dimensional GELU projection.
Ordinary/red tile occupancy and six-channel meld features are conditioned on a projected public-state vector.

Occupied hand entries use 16-row buckets up to 128 rows and 512-row buckets above that; deduplicated suit rows use 16 or 4096. Padding is removed before scattering 512-wide encodings into the hand bank.

nodes.title: Shared river encoder
nodes.summary: A parameter-tied convolutional encoder processes pre-riichi and post-riichi opponent discard sequences.
details: Validity masking is reapplied after each convolution; padded tokens and empty streams remain zero.
Flattened ordered stream embeddings and max-pooled summaries enter the board projection.
Mean- and max-pooled stream embeddings also enter per-player critic descriptors.
The computation graph contains neither river self-attention nor candidate-to-river cross-attention.

nodes.title: Residual board trunk
nodes.summary: Concatenated public scalars, hand-bank summaries and river embeddings enter a four-block residual MLP.
details: Numeric channels are cast to float32, flattened and transformed by elementwise arcsinh.
Yaku-feasibility axes use shared linear basis projections grouped by channel width.
Each pre-normalized residual block expands 512→1536 with GELU, contracts to 512 and adds the skip connection.
The terminal board representation is normalized in float32 with center=False, scale=False and epsilon=1e−5.

nodes.title: Decision candidates
nodes.summary: Action-indexed embeddings combine hand-bank gathers, shared board context and deterministic action descriptors.
details: The canonical index space partitions into 37 discard, 74 riichi/discard, 149 response and 35 kan slots.
The 150-way response head appends an open-kan score gathered from the triggering tile’s kan candidate.
Only active candidate rows enter learned evaluation; absent candidate slots are constant padding.
WIN maps both policy branches to current-hand candidate 260; there is no separate accept/decline value estimator.

nodes.title: Opponent beliefs
nodes.summary: Categorical shanten/count marginals and conditional Bernoulli improving-tile marginals share the board encoder.
details: Observed meld counts define support lower bounds; unavailable-copy counts define support upper bounds.
Count projection enforces concealed-hand cardinality and tile-copy availability constraints.
Riichi or four fixed melds mask non-tenpai shanten logits.
Outputs are constrained marginals; they do not parameterize a normalized joint distribution over concealed hands.

nodes.title: Tile interaction refinement
nodes.summary: Two opponent-shared transformer blocks apply additive residual corrections to count and conditional-ukeire logits.
details: Pre-LayerNorm self-attention and 64→128→64 GELU residual MLPs share parameters across opponents.
Token inputs concatenate initial marginal probabilities, tile identity, availability, meld lower bounds, shanten probabilities and projected board context.
A zero-initialized 64→14 projection produces ordinary/red count and four shanten-conditioned ukeire corrections.
The shanten logits are not modified by this residual attention output.

nodes.title: Policy and completion heads
nodes.summary: A shared scalar candidate-scoring head is partitioned and gathered into phase-specific policy logits.
details: Candidate features include three route-affinity logits and three opponent-ron logits.
Board-conditioned heads produce binary win/pass logits and per-player ron/tsumo completion-yaku and score-state logits.
Native legality masks, opening-symmetry pooling and final-wall safety transforms precede action selection.
MMD optimizes legal-action probability mass against detached Q and reference-policy KL terms; supervised restoration is a separate objective.

nodes.title: Four-player context
nodes.summary: A shared affine/GELU map embeds four distinct player descriptors conditioned on a common candidate representation.
details: The self indicator and dealer indicator are independent descriptor coordinates; they can both equal one for the acting player.
Descriptors concatenate observed meld identities, seat-wind scoring consequences, dora, score/rank context and public opponent evidence.
Action-conditioned coordinates encode projected ordinary draws, chi-turn eligibility and discard-source identity.
Parameter sharing does not imply identical player embeddings or permutation invariance of the full seat-ordered encoder.

nodes.title: Joint hand critic
nodes.summary: Shared player/role projections parameterize event, conditional-deposit and claim-score factors of a current-hand outcome model.
details: Nonlinear role pooling produces logits over whole winner/draw masks; player win probabilities are not independently factorized.
Claim heads parameterize added-bonus-han categories and conditional hand-score support.
Hand-score factors for simultaneous winning claimants retain the conditional product factorization.
Call-conditioned predictions model attempted calls, including priority preemption by competing claims.

nodes.title: Rule-based settlement
nodes.summary: A deterministic support decoder maps event, claim-score and deposit states to transfers, scores and ranks.
details: Triple-ron support is mapped to the simulator’s abort event.
Public yaku, fu, bonus and settlement-legality masks restrict probability support.
Unsupported liability/nagashi allocations are masked from payment NLL and retained in support-coverage statistics.

nodes.title: Fixed match continuation
nodes.summary: A fixed score-to-rank continuation model supplies per-settlement payoffs for critic expectations.
details: Terminal settlements use realized score/rank state, deterministic tie priority and rounded ST3.
Nonterminal forecasts condition on post-hand scores, scheduled hands remaining and future dealer counts.
The common Gumbel scale is the square root of a positive quadratic variance; a positive dealer-count coefficient shifts score locations.
The graph contains no learned state-value head or final-match-return regression target.

training.title: Mortal match
training.description: Collect 10,000 standard-South trajectories against the fixed Mortal opponent using 2,500 wall seeds and all four learner-seat rotations. Convert recoverable decisions from every seat into observed current-hand transfer supervision.

training.title: Observed settlement fit
training.description: Perform one finite pass of supported played-action transfer-vector NLL plus critic constraints. Gradients propagate through critic-private parameters and connected shared representation paths; unplayed candidates have no supervised transfer target.

training.title: Magnetic mirror descent
training.description: Perform one finite MMD pass over retained decisions, using detached critic expectations, a phase-frozen previous-policy reference and a run-frozen production reference. Actor constraint coefficient: 0.01.

training.title: Balanced root reruns
training.description: Sample equal counts of eligible targeted roots and unfiltered normal roots, with two continuations per root. Eligibility strata are Q disagreement, tenpai, keiten, improving calls, riichi, public threat and sakigiri. Q disagreement threshold: 0.0025 J.

training.title: Train roots and descendants
training.description: Apply the same critic→actor pass sequence to all retained root and continuation rows. Forced root actions and opponent actions supply off-policy experience, not cross-entropy policy targets.
training.formula: all retained root and descendant rows → critic → actor

training.title: Optimization and replicas
training.description: Use independent AdamW optimizer states for actor and critic: learning rate 5e−6, weight decay 1e−4 and per-variable clipnorm 1. Sum dense gradients across replicas once before clipping. Exclude padding from masked reductions; physical batch layout can still affect floating-point updates.

training.title: Independent next match
training.description: Evaluate each updated checkpoint on the next disjoint 10,000-game seed block. Reuse that match as the next iteration’s data; terminate after the final evaluation without a subsequent optimizer pass.

training.title: Separate structural restoration
training.description: Separate supervised restoration losses consume observed action labels and hidden-state targets. These losses are not included in the current MMD improvement schedule.

outputs.win_decision_logits: Two categorical logits: decline (0), accept the currently legal ron/tsumo opportunity (1). Apply softmax on the last axis.
outputs.opponent_shanten_logits: Categorical logits over four clipped shanten classes per opponent; class 0 denotes tenpai. Public constraints mask non-tenpai support where required.
outputs.discard_policy_logits: Legality-constrained categorical action logits over 34 ordinary tile classes plus three red-five classes.
outputs.riichi_policy_logits: Joint categorical action logits over declaration status × discard class: 37 dama choices followed by 37 riichi choices.
outputs.response_policy_logits: Categorical action logits with support [pass, 3×37 chi/discard, 1×37 pon/discard, open kan]; total width 150.
outputs.riichi_action_logits: Branch log-masses obtained by logsumexp over discard classes for dama and riichi; softmax yields the declaration marginal.
outputs.response_action_logits: Branch log-masses for pass, chi, pon and open kan, computed by logsumexp over compatible joint response actions.
outputs.chi_pattern_logits: Logsumexp aggregates over follow-up discards for each of the three chi patterns; softmax gives the pattern distribution conditional on the chi branch.
outputs.kan_action_logits: Categorical logits over decline followed by 34 tile-indexed kan candidates; total width 35.
outputs.terminal_payment_probabilities: Policy-mixture categorical transfer marginals indexed by payment kind, payer, recipient and amount-support class.
outputs.payment_values: Per-position monetary support vector: fixed PAYMENT_VALUES followed by four public-state-dependent bank atoms.
outputs.final_placement_probabilities: Policy-mixture actor final-rank marginal obtained by integrating current-hand outcomes through the fixed continuation distribution.
outputs.review_outcome_probabilities: Policy-mixture marginal over seven disjoint event categories: deal-in, actor win, tenpai draw, noten draw, opponent tsumo, other ron and abort.
outputs.settlement_mean: First moment of policy-mixture honba-free net transfers for actor-relative players 0–3 and bank. The underlying joint support retains inter-transfer covariance.
outputs.settlement_variance: Elementwise second central moment of policy-mixture honba-free player/bank net transfers: max(E[X²] − E[X]², 0).
outputs.critic_expected_points: Per-active-candidate expected post-hand score minus current score for four actor-relative players, in points.
outputs.critic_action_indices: Sparse row index pairs [input-position index, canonical critic-action index]. All other critic_* outputs share this row ordering.

auxiliaries.name: opponent_hand_count_logits
auxiliaries.title: Opponent hand count logits

auxiliaries.name: round_completion_yaku_logits

auxiliaries.name: round_completion_score_logits

mathematics.title: Legal policy normalization
mathematics.description: Select the native active head, right-pad to width 150, apply the exact legality mask and compute float32 log_softmax. Masked logits use the finite −10⁹ sentinel; their exponentials underflow to zero under the normal float32 logit scale. Native head indices and decision_phase IDs are distinct enumerations.

mathematics.description: Push forward active-head probability mass onto the 295-element critic index space. Open-kan response mass is scatter-added to the trigger-tile kan index. mathematics.title: Observed payment likelihood
mathematics.description: Maximize the likelihood of the observed transfer vector conditional on the recorded action by marginalizing compatible latent event, deposit and score states. The objective is not an independent-cell composite likelihood. Ambiguous zero-transfer observations remain marginalized; simultaneous-claim score factors preserve the implemented conditional product factorization.

Parameter tying does not impose representation equality or global permutation invariance.
